newDebate.title: What should we debate?
newDebate.aiNotice: Everything this debate produces — arguments, reviews, scores and the verdict — is generated by AI models, machine-readably marked, and may be inaccurate.
newDebate.freePromise: Every gauge fixed. The question is yours.
newDebate.topicPlaceholder: Type a debatable claim or question…
newDebate.freeIntro: Free runs every debate at fixed settings. Type your question and click Start, or choose Premium to set the gauges yourself.
newDebate.premiumIntro: Choose your risk tier, composition budget tier, and depth, then click Start.
newDebate.riskFreeHint: How much is riding on the answer · fixed by the Free plan
newDebate.riskPremiumHint: How much is riding on the answer · explicit asker selection
newDebate.budgetFreeHint: How much work the composition may spend · fixed by the Free plan
newDebate.budgetPremiumHint: How much work the composition may spend · provisional default, editable
newDebate.treeDepthHint: How far the debate expands when cross-maker review is available
newDebate.steeringPlaceholder:
Prefer primary sources
Surface the strongest counter-case early
newDebate.annotationsHint: Free text · logged verbatim, one per line
newDebate.annotationsPlaceholder: Add a note the run will carry…
newDebate.provenance: Tier source, provenance, and machine as-of are recorded automatically with the run contract.
newDebate.legacyNotice: Depth mode, depth of scrutiny, branching width, concurrency, and max tokens are V2 controls the V3 run contract has no slot for — they are not sent.
newDebate.scrutinyDeepHint: More follow-up rounds on weak points
newDebate.scrutinyExhaustiveHint: Agents keep digging until the tree goes quiet
newDebate.roleOverrides: Role overrides are not user-editable — model role assignment lives in
newDebate.defaultUnavailable: The deployment has no valid riskTier row; Risk tier awaits input.
newDebate.invalidAsOf: As of must be a valid date and time.
newDebate.asOfProvenance: ask time (refreshed when Start is clicked)
requestFailure.subject.SESSION_DEFAULTS: Reading your session's defaults did not complete.
requestFailure.subject.DEBATE_CREATE: Starting this debate did not complete.
requestFailure.kind.REFUSED: The coordinator answered and refused it. Sign in again, then retry.
requestFailure.kind.MISSING: The coordinator holds nothing at that address.
requestFailure.kind.BUSY: There have been too many requests in a short time. Please wait a little, then try again.
requestFailure.kind.DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED: We've reached today's limit for new debates. Please try again tomorrow.
requestFailure.kind.UNREACHABLE: The coordinator could not be reached, so the outcome is unknown.
requestFailure.kind.SERVER_FAILED: The coordinator failed while handling it, so the outcome is unknown.
requestFailure.kind.UNREADABLE: The coordinator's reply could not be read, so the outcome is unknown.
requestFailure.kind.PLAN_TIER_INVALID: The coordinator refused the plan choice. Choose Free or Premium, then retry.
requestFailure.kind.PLAN_TIER_UNAVAILABL: The coordinator refused it: a model this plan needs is not available right now. Retry later, or choose the other plan.
requestFailure.kind.ALREADY_WAITING: One question can wait at a time. Ask this one after your waiting debate has started.
requestFailure.kind.UNCLASSIFIED: It failed before any answer arrived, so the outcome is unknown. This is not a decision the coordinator made.
newDebate.legalGate.title: Please read and accept the current documents
newDebate.legalGate.body: Before you continue, open each document below, read it to the end, then accept it.
newDebate.legalGate.failed: Your acceptance could not be saved. Please try again.
newDebate.legalGate.stale: One of the documents changed a moment ago. Reload the page to read the current version.
newDebate.legalGate.signOutFailed: Signing out did not complete. Please try again.
newDebate.room.locationBlocked: New debates can't be started from your current location. Your debates stay available to read.
newDebate.room.siteFull: Today's limit is reached. You can still ask — your debate will start by itself when the limit resets.
newDebate.room.siteClose: You're close to today's limit. This debate will still run in full; later ones may wait until the reset.
newDebate.room.alreadyWaiting: One question can wait at a time. Yours will start at {time}; ask this one after that.
newDebate.room.personDayFull: You've reached today's limit for your plan. You can still ask: your debate will start by itself at {time}. Or upgrade to start now.
newDebate.room.personWeekFull: You've reached this week's limit for your plan. You can still ask: your debate will start by itself on {time}. Or upgrade to start now.
newDebate.room.personMonthFull: You've reached this month's limit for your plan. You can still ask: your debate will start by itself on {time}. Or upgrade to start now.
newDebate.room.personDayFullTopPlan: You've reached today's limit for your plan. You can still ask: your debate will start by itself at {time}.
newDebate.room.personWeekFullTopPlan: You've reached this week's limit for your plan. You can still ask: your debate will start by itself on {time}.
newDebate.room.personMonthFullTopPlan: You've reached this month's limit for your plan. You can still ask: your debate will start by itself on {time}.
newDebate.room.freeMonthFull: You've used this month's free debate allowance. Your next debate can start on {time}, or choose a plan to continue now.
newDebate.room.personClose: You're close to your plan's limit. This debate will still run in full.
